repos_data.description: 🤖 Local-assist BOSS Zhipin CLI for AI agents — search, welfare filtering, shortlist, JSON-envelope output; low-risk & compliant by default.
AI job agent: scans 130+ careers pages nightly, scores every role against your resume with an LLM (0–100), alerts you on Telegram, and drafts tailored cover letters + resumes. Free & open source.
MCP server for JobGPT — search jobs, auto-apply, generate resumes, and track applications from Claude, Cursor, Windsurf, and any MCP client
Remote jobs MCP server — search 100,000+ remote jobs, post listings, find candidates, and check salary benchmarks from Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, and any MCP client. Free, no API key required.

Companies screen you with AI. Screen them back. Let your AI assistant find jobs straight from employers' own ATS: is the job still open, is the company real, did the posting you applied to close. Résumé stays on your machine. MCP server, MIT.
Dreamwork MCP server: job search, tailored application materials, and application tracking for AI assistants.
Indeed MCP server by HasData: search job listings and read full postings, as JSON.
Detect fake recruiter & job-offer scams with free OSINT — an MCP server for Claude. No API keys.

Personal job-search assistant for Claude Desktop: searches real job boards, has Claude score each job 0-100 for fit, and shows a ranked board with one-click triage. MCP App, runs locally, no API keys.

Stop rewriting your resume for every job. Give Claude, ChatGPT or Codex your career: they find jobs that fit, tailor a resume from your real history in under a minute, answer the questions and fill the application. You press Submit. Every AI edit is a diff you approve. Free, open source, lives on your laptop. ~$0.01 per application.

MCP server that gives AI clients structured, searchable access to a local folder of resume files (PDF, DOCX, MD, TXT), exposing tools for querying resumes, work experiences, achievements, skills, side projects, and education.
Search jobs, track applications, and set follow-up reminders from your AI assistant — Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor & any MCP client. Free, OAuth.
MCP server for public Ashby job boards. Resolve a company to its board, search its openings and the pay it publishes. No API key.
MCP server for public Lever job boards. Search a company's openings, read one in full. No API key.

Watch company job boards (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workable, Workday, Eightfold, Rippling), get a ranked digest of new matches, track every application, and use it from Claude via MCP. Never auto-applies.
